searchText: This guy at least asked. And that kind of confusion is why moving away from “eth2” is worth the effort. <https://www.reddit.com/r/ethereum/comments/pty1y8/if_i_buy_ethereum_will_it_also_be_ethereum_20/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=ios_app&utm_name=iossmf> <@552133098075193354> <@301186049323958275> <@420951281910284289> thank you for your input. I’ll do my part pushing the Eth consensus/execution nomenclature 🙏🏾 Ugh, reading over that thread shows how confused people are (even those that are helping/answering) by the naming convention. 😖 Like this comment, that just increases the liklihood that someone gets scammed around The Merge by someone selling "ETH2 coins": > If you buy ETH now it is ETH2 when the POS launch. Anyone familiar with https://eth.wiki/ ? It seems the wiki is not open for edit? <@250259755484839957> would know could we add more resources on the proposed Statelessness to the Ethereum Wiki? The enitre wiki is a bit out of date. In general, ethereum.org is more actively maintained. the wiki will be deprecated in the near future in favor of ethereum.org
